CONFIDENTIAL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. ............
8/d/6h//
Date July 16, 1937

Subject Communication dated 7-7-37 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Mrs H.A. Udeleff.

Made by D. S. I. Prokofiev Forwarded by

* Acc l.o
D ...

Enquiries show that Mrs. Helen Abramovna UDELEFF,
Russian of Jewish extraction, was born in 1897 at Petrograd.
She has been residing in Shanghai since 1926, during which time
she has been conducting her own business - " Madame Helene ", Ladies
Dressmaking Establishment - at present situated at 974 Bubbling
Well Road . In 1934 -1935 she was connected with Whiteway, Laid-
law & Co., Ltd in Shanghai where she was in charge of the Milline-
ry, Costume and Corset Salon.

She is a widow and has a daughter 22 years of age .
Until about 1931 Mrs Udeleff is reported to have been a paramour
of a wealthy Frenchman who is well known in business and social
circles in Shanghai, and to have been supported by him.

While in Shanghai Mrs Udeleff did not come to the
notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any activities
of an undesirable character.

She is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Commit-
tee, 118/1 Moulmein Road.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

el.
D. C. ( Special Branch )
DSI

由 D. S. I. Prokofiev 撰写 转呈者

* Acc l.o
D ...

经查，Helen Abramovna UDELEFF（海伦·阿布拉莫夫娜·乌杰列夫）夫人，系犹太裔俄国人，1897年生于彼得格勒。
她自1926年起居住于上海，在此期间经营自己的生意——“Madame Helene”女士裁缝店——现址位于静安寺路974号。1934至1935年间，她与上海的Whiteway, Laidlaw & Co., Ltd.（惠泰洋行）有关联，负责该行的女帽、时装及紧身胸衣沙龙。

她是一名寡妇，育有一名22岁的女儿。
据报，直至约1931年，Udeleff夫人曾是一位在上海商界和社交界颇有名气的富有的法国人的情妇，并由其供养。

Udeleff夫人在上海期间，未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

她在慕尔鸣路118/1号的俄国侨民委员会登记在册。

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I. （侦探副督察）

el.
D. C. （特科）

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 2220.                                SHANGHAI,       7th July 1937.

Sir,

    I have the honour to inform you that Mrs. Helen
Abramovna UDELEVA has applied to this Consulate for
a vise for admission into the Netherlands Indies.
    She is in possession of a passport issued by the
Bureau of Public Safety at Shanghai, No. 4879/5/VIII/
1936, valid only for Tsingtao, but will apply for a
new passport valid for the Netherlands Indies.
    According to her passport she is born at Petrograd
in 1897.
    Her profession is a dressmaker, her business address
at 974 Bubbling Well Road, and her private address at the
Ascot Apartments, Apartment 105, Bubbling Well Road.
    She intends to leave on the 29th July with the s. s.
"Tjinegara" for Bali and the Netherlands Indies and return
after a stay of about 3 weeks. The purpose of the trip
is recreation.
    I should be much obliged to you if you would let me
know, if possible, whether anything is known against this
person from a political or moral point of view.

                                    I have the honour to be,

                                                Sir,

                                    Your obedient servant,

                                    Vice-Consul.

Major K. M. Bourne
Officer i/c Special Branch
Shanghai Municipal Police,
                SHANGHAI.

（印：... - 8 JULY 1937 ...）

（批：S. 1 / ... / DB 87）

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA

第2220号。                                上海，       1937年7月7日。

先生：

    谨此通知您，Helen
Abramovna UDELEVA（乌杰列娃）夫人已向本领事馆申请
进入荷属东印度的签证。
    她持有上海公安局签发的护照，号码为4879/5/VIII/
1936，仅适用于青岛，但她将申请一本适用于荷属东印度的新护照。
    根据其护照记载，她于1897年生于彼得格勒。
    她的职业是裁缝，营业地址在静安寺路974号，私人住址在
静安寺路阿斯科特公寓105室。
    她打算于7月29日乘坐“Tjinegara”号轮船前往巴厘岛和荷属东印度，
停留约3周后返回。此行目的为休闲度假。
    如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否掌握对此人不利的情况，
我将不胜感激。

                                    谨致，

                                                先生，

                                    您顺从的仆人，

                                    副领事。

K. M. Bourne 少校
特科主管警官
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
                上海。

（印：... - 1937年7月8日 ...）

（批：S. 1 / ... / DB 87）
